title: Atomic caller-precomputed Wide projection publication through existing column owners

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the finite declared publication target
claim.meaning: Curated index to actually observed root commands, source and captures. Shape, hashes alone and correlated model agreement are not behavioral proof.

risk.boundary: Persistent parent/child directory and checksum envelope; writer API
risk.rollback: One exact-path atomic local feature commit; no push, dependency change or history rewrite.

api: WidePartProjection.precomputed(name, key_name, keys : Slice(UInt64), columns : Array(WidePartColumn), rows_per_mark = 8192)
laws: Caller supplies precomputed rows and matching table DDL; no SELECT/provenance/freshness claim.
Parent and child retain independent bounded nonempty UInt64 key streams, order, row counts and grids.
Existing per-column owner admission/codecs are reused; parent and all children share mutable planning/codec/transport/readback budgets.
Stage children under the unpublished parent, validate typed values and exact summary, then publish the complete parent exclusively.
Child checksum summary: sum checksummed physical sizes; sorted name records of LE UInt64 name byte length, name bytes, LE low/high hash; ordinary zero-key CH SipHash-128 with 0xff finalization.
admitted.consumer_prerequisite: Only already-admitted primitive numeric arrays: known global String versions 0/1 with propagation true, empty Default statistics in bounded UInt64-keyed N-column schemas, and complete unique exact-substream name-set normalization into canonical read order. No Sparse or new family layout.
admitted.native_profile: Wide/LZ4/Default/plain-mrk2/plain primary index/with_size_stream; native fixture id UInt64, score UInt64, label String, items Array(UInt16).

local_refusals: Nested projections, raw-file injection and empty child parts
Invalid/duplicate projection names, path/stream collisions, symlinks and existing destinations
Unadmitted column owners, non-UInt64 keys and independent counter resets
Unknown array serialization versions, false version propagation, Sparse and duplicate/missing/extra substreams
non_guarantees: Projection SELECT parsing/evaluation, automatic materialization and optimizer policy
SQL equivalence, data provenance, freshness, server Active state and MV capability widening
Every type/product inside projections, Compact writing, cross-version/endianness portability
OS maximum-path portability, crash durability or cross-process concurrency qualification
Full-repository suite, allocation/RSS/throughput improvement and global <=10% speed parity

reused_without_new_codec: WidePartMetadata and existing per-column physical/codec/readback owners

boundaries.excluded: No unrelated user changes, raw captures, temporary root auditors, generated binaries, source archives or private datasets.

laws: MergedBlockOutputStream.cpp:233-239 folds finalized child summary into the parent .proj checksum entry.
MergeTreeDataPartChecksum.cpp:99-105,333-361 and SipHash.h:70-90,196-202 define the sorted size/hash summary and ordinary CH 128-bit finalization.
SerializationInfo.cpp:432-442,505-509,742-770; DataTypeArray.cpp:61-66; SerializationArray.cpp:273-292,352-397: Default statistics and array element delegation/stream enumeration.
ColumnsSubstreams.cpp:227-260 and MergeTreeReaderWide.cpp:1197-1219 resolve separate Wide substreams by name.
optimizeUseNormalProjection.cpp:822 sets the actual read-step description; ReadFromMergeTree.cpp:6331-6363 conditionally emits analysis Projections. Name-only analysis is not proof of use.
reference_source.provenance: Official depth-1 comparison source is distinct from the executed pinned runtime; original archive remains untouched. No continuing upstream freshness claim.

toolchain.execution: Root-only serialized heavy commands; no simultaneous compiler/helper/native/auditor runs.

source_freeze.scope: 17 changed source/spec/runner files remained identical throughout final affected tests, helpers, fresh native captures and root audits; only docs/packet changed afterward.

Caller must compute semantically correct projection rows and supply matching DDL; physical validity does not certify source derivation.
Remaining aggregate state grammars/shells/combinators, JSON RE2/SKIP REGEXP, legacy inline and remaining recursive/layout products are open.
General MV transformation execution/output appenders, composite/non-UInt64 key and partition derivation, Compact writing and server lifecycle remain open.
Large facades remain incompletely decomposed; no new memory/RSS/performance claim.

continuation.active_goal: Complete supported types and MV/projection storage/execution before memory/performance optimization; hostile self-review each feature; global speed target remains unmeasured.
continuation.confirmed_frontier: W256 precomputed projection publication qualified; no MV execution widening.
continuation.next_proposed_slice: Selected-source-part scan through existing DDL/type preflight, caller-run Crystal transform, target-schema-bound detached output; preserve existing owner-specific recursive values and independent output keys.
continuation.next_falsifier: Source keys [1,2,3] with JSON/Dynamic inputs; callback filters 2 and computes changed String output at keys [1,3]. Wrong target schema/UUID and a callback failure after partial append leave no destination/candidate-set change.
continuation.standing_authority: In-scope reversible local work and atomic feature commit; heavy work delegated to Luna, root verifies. No push/history rewrite/production mutation.

availability.raw_artifacts: Present at recording in isolated /private/tmp directories; ephemeral and not committed. Rebuild/requalify on capture loss or changed pins.
decay_triggers: Raw capture or temporary audit-instrument loss
availability.refresh: Recheck source/pins, run ordered affected DEBUG/RELEASE rosters, build separate helpers, generate fresh two native cells, rerun raw/literal/adversary replay.
availability.failure_policy: Reopen/downgrade only dependent W256 claims; do not treat a green field or a safe rejection as capability closure.
